profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Keen-nosed and strongly interested in game, the hunting Laikas tend to be steady but vigorous workers. East Siberian, West Siberian and Russian-European Laikas are distinct breeds shaped by regional hunting traditions. The wider Laika family also includes the Yakutian, whose traditional work combines pulling sleds with hunting.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Steady but vigorous, hunting Laikas pair keen scenting with game interest; the wider family also includes sled workers.
